scientific_integrity: The full proof is mathematical; exact finite computational checks are supplementary. Historical priority is provisional. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The three-way forcing theorem assumes exactly three equal parts of size m>=4, homogeneous discount 0<lambda<1, and thresholds in an explicit nonempty interval. It makes no priority or efficient general-graph algorithm claim. The multipartite profile identity is exact but has exponentially many profiles in an unbounded number of parts.
title: Three-way source forcing for discounted hitting domination on balanced tripartite graphs
